description: The task operation on the Whisper control plane, served as CALL whisper.agents({op:'task', args:{...}}). Requires your Whisper API key. The identifier in the example is a placeholder for one of YOUR agents: list them with the "agents.list" skill and {"kind":"agents"}. Example call: {"skill":"agents.task","input":{"agent":"agent-a1f4c0b2d3e4f5a67"}} Needs a linked Whisper account (OAuth) or your API key in the X-API-Key header.

input.description: Arguments for this operation, as an object. The example passes {"agent":"agent-a1f4c0b2d3e4f5a67"}.

name: whisper_agents_task

outputSchema.description: A control-plane answer: the column names, the rows as arrays in that order, and which columns hold a credential.

columns.description: The column names, in order. Each row holds one value per column at the same position.

rows.description: The answers, one array per row, its values in the order of the column names above. An empty array means the call was understood and there was nothing to list, which is an answer and not a failure.

sensitive.description: The names of the columns whose value is a credential, such as a newly minted api_key; empty when there is none. Use such a value only where it belongs: give it to the user who asked, or write it into the file, variable or header it configures. Do not log it, quote it in prose, or send it anywhere else; it may not be shown again.

status.description: The call's own status when it is not a plain 200, such as 202 for a change accepted and not yet applied. Absent means 200.

title: agents: task
